type MessageActivity {
  id: Int!
  recipientId: Int
  messengerId: Int
  type: ActivityType
  replyCount: Int!
  message(
    asHtml: Boolean
  ): String
  isLocked: Boolean
  isSubscribed: Boolean
  likeCount: Int!
  isLiked: Boolean
  isPinned: Boolean
  isPrivate: Boolean
  siteUrl: String
  createdAt: Int!
  recipient: User
  messenger: User
  replies: [ActivityReply]
  likes: [User]
}
